defective_pattern: Retaining legacy text in Section 4-4 that claims to address both Question 2 and Question 3 after Question 3 has been extracted into its own dedicated Section 4-5.
why_defective: Creates direct internal contradiction between section title and body prose, confuses the reader, and leaves disjointed subsection numbering in downstream sections.
observed_symptoms: Introductory text saying 'these two questions' in a single-question section
Blockquotes for Question X appearing in Section Y
corrective_remedy: Surgically rewrite the introductory paragraph of each question/hypothesis section to introduce only its own question, move Question 3's formal blockquote and measurement description into Section 4-5, and fix subsection numbering to follow strict parent hierarchy.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of multiple question identifiers or multi-question phrasing ('دو سوال') under a single-question heading.
